title: Linux: Game view: in lores/pixel art game, Alt+RMB (Show list of all nodes at position clicked) shows popup with ugly font
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M (nvidia; 535.183.01) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4710HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz (8 threads) ### Issue description In the Game view only, showing the list of nodes under the cursor with Alt+RMB (Ctrl+Alt+RMB on desktops/window managers where Alt+RMB shows window contextual menu) shows a popup with a very ugly, pixelated (aliased) font. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2827c5ec-fac9-48a2-9526-99fdaa456681) I thought it was because it was trying to render at my pixel game pixel scale, but the pixel size is not the same at all, but it must not be it. I suspect it's a Linux-only bug, but I only tested Linux Ubuntu 22.04 with Unity desktop (I can try Windows 11 later but probably most people can - would be interested to know how other Linux distros/desktops manage it). In comparison, the Scene view popup is much cleaner: ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0502a216-0145-471b-ae1e-5f4325968ed9) Not only the font, but also there are nice colored icons as in the Scene tree. Is the Game view popup intended to look the same? ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create some nodes 2. Play the game 3. Alt+RMB on the Game view (or Ctrl+Alt+RMB , Shift+Alt+RMB, Meta+Alt+RMB if your window manager shows an unrelated contextual menu) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A EDIT: I replaced "click" with "RMB" (right mouse button), I must have mistyped it the first time since it wouldn't make sense for Alt+left-click to show that contextual menu on some systems, and I could verify that I needed RMB indeed, except when enabling "Show list of selectable nodes at position clicked" where I just use Left/Primary Click (without Alt)
